label: LinkedIn Ads Scraper
title: LinkedIn Ads Scraper: Ad Library Creatives & Targeting
metaDescription: Extract LinkedIn Ad Library data: creatives, headlines, copy, advertiser info and targeting. Search by keyword, advertiser or date range.
intro: Search the LinkedIn Ad Library by keyword, advertiser or date and get each ad's creative, headline, copy, advertiser and targeting details.
useCases: See how B2B competitors position themselves in ads
Collect ad copy for messaging research
Track when competitors start or stop campaigns

faq.q: Is there a LinkedIn Ad Library API?
faq.a: No. LinkedIn's Marketing APIs only return your own ad accounts. This actor searches the public Ad Library by keyword, advertiser or date and returns each ad's creative, copy and details.

faq.q: Can I see a competitor's LinkedIn ads?
faq.a: Yes: search by the company name or paste an Ad Library search link; every ad they ran in the window comes back with its format, copy and call to action.

faq.q: Can I use it as a LinkedIn Ad Library API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

officialApi: LinkedIn's Ad Library has no public API; LinkedIn's Marketing APIs only cover your own ad accounts. This actor reads the public Ad Library search.
